# (APPENDIX) Bijlagen {-}

# Samenstelling van de typegroepen {#app:typegroups}

```{r results='asis'}
typegroups <- 
    targetpop %>% 
    inner_join(schemes, by = "scheme") %>% 
    select(scheme, 
           scheme_name, 
           typegroup, 
           typegroup_name, 
           typeclass_name, 
           type, 
           type_name, 
           type_shortname)

for (i in unique(filter(typegroups, !is.na(typegroup))$scheme)) {
    
    typegroups_i <- 
        typegroups %>% 
        filter(scheme == i)
    
    scheme_name <- 
        typegroups_i %>% 
        distinct(scheme, scheme_name) %>% 
        pull(scheme_name)
    
    cat("## ", as.character(scheme_name), " (", i, ")\n\n", sep = "")

    for (j in (unique(typegroups_i$typegroup) %>% as.character %>% sort)) {
        
        typegroup_name <- 
            typegroups_i %>% 
            distinct(typegroup, typegroup_name) %>% 
            filter(typegroup == j) %>% 
            pull(typegroup_name)
        
        cat("### ", as.character(typegroup_name), " (", j, ")\n\n", sep = "")
        
        typegroups_i %>% 
            filter(typegroup == j) %>% 
            select(typeclass = typeclass_name,
                   type,
                   type_name, 
                   type_shortname) %>% 
            pandoc.table(split.table = Inf,
                         justify = "left")
}
}
```
